params.name: sku
params.description: A seller-provided Product ID

params.name: customerOrderId
params.description: The customer order ID

params.name: purchaseOrderId
params.description: The purchase order ID. One customer may have multiple purchase orders.

params.name: status
params.description: Status of purchase order line. Valid statuses are: Created, Acknowledged, Shipped, Delivered and Cancelled.

params.name: createdStartDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created after this date. Default is current date - 7 days. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

params.name: createdEndDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were created before this date. Default is current date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

params.name: fromExpectedShipDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date after this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

params.name: toExpectedShipDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that have order lines with an expected ship date before this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ)

params.name: lastModifiedStartDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were modified after this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

params.name: lastModifiedEndDate
params.description: Fetches all purchase orders that were modified before this date. Use either UTC or ISO 8601 formats. Date example: '2020-03-16'(yyyy-MM-dd). Date with Timestamp example: '2020-03-16T10:30:15Z'(yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZ).

params.name: limit
params.description: The number of orders to be returned. Cannot be larger than 200.

params.name: productInfo
params.description: Provides the image URL and product weight in response, if available. Allowed values are true or false.

params.name: shipNodeType
params.description: Specifies the type of shipNode. Allowed values are SellerFulfilled(Default), WFSFulfilled and 3PLFulfilled.

params.name: shippingProgramType
params.description: Specifies the type of program. Allowed value is TWO_DAY, ONE_DAY.

params.name: replacementInfo
params.description: Provides additional attributes - originalCustomerOrderID, orderType - related to Replacement order, in response, if available. Allowed values are true or false.

params.name: orderType
params.description: Specifies if the order is a regular order or replacement order. Possible values are REGULAR or REPLACEMENT. Provided in response only if query parameter replacementInfo=true.

items.docs:
Retrieves the details of all the orders for specified search criteria.

Only orders created in last 180 days and a maximum of 20000 orders can be fetched at a time. Attempting to download more than 20000 orders will return an error.

items.docs:
Retrieves all the orders with line items that are in the "created" status, that is, these orders have been released from the Walmart Order Management System to the seller for processing. The released orders are the orders that are ready for a seller to fulfill.

Only orders created in last 180 days and a maximum of 20000 orders can be fetched at a time. Attempting to download more than 20000 orders will return an error.
